How far the pointer moved sideways since the last time this function was called. It gives the same result whether the pointer reached the edge of the window or not, which makes it useful for looking around in a 3D scene: call [MoveMouse](MoveMouse) every frame to put the pointer back in the middle and use the speed as the turning amount.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local x = 160
While Not KeyHit(1)
	x = x + MouseXSpeed()
	MoveMouse 160, 120
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Move the mouse sideways"
	Oval x - 8, 110, 16, 16, 1
	Flip
Wend
```
@returns The change of the horizontal position since the previous call.
@gap Putting the pointer somewhere with MoveMouse does not count as movement, the same as in the original. To make that work on every platform the window captures the pointer for as long as the program keeps calling MoveMouse; it lets go about 300 milliseconds after the last call.
